description:
Inject bound communication tools into orchestrated child sessions only. Do not load the minions extension in children.

## Background

Children must not get parent `orchestrate`/`spawn`/`halt`/`send_minion_message`. Comm tools are closures with sender identity fixed at inject time. Spawn children do not get these tools.

## Tools (names are an implementation choice)

- list peers in the group (id, role, taskType, description, state)
- send to a live peer or to the parent
- announce path intent / inspect intent (or leave announce to the paths issue; if so, provide the inject hook only)

## Success criteria

- Orchestrated child tool list includes comm, not halt/orchestrate.
- Spawn child tool list does not include comm.
- Child cannot pass `from` identity.

## Test plan

- Unit: inject binds childId.
- Integration: spawn vs orchestrate tool names.

## Considerations

This issue owns the inject hook in the runner. Coordinate with runner's extra-tools list rather than rewriting allowlist math.
title: Inject bound comm tools into orchestrated children only
